context:
Edit two config files and update CI references. No code moves, no new
packages, no compatibility shims.
description:
BenchBox ships `benchbox/release/` (~2,300 lines) and the `benchbox-sync`
console entry point to all users via MANIFEST.in and pyproject.toml. These
are maintainer-only tools for release automation, repository sync, and
content validation.

Coupling analysis confirmed near-zero coupling: release imports only
`benchbox.utils.printing.emit`, and core BenchBox never imports from release.

The fix is three small edits:
1. Remove `benchbox-sync` from `[project.scripts]` in pyproject.toml.
2. Add `prune benchbox/release` to MANIFEST.in so the wheel excludes it.
3. Optionally add a `[maintainer]` extra that re-exposes the entry point for
   explicit installs.

A full `benchbox-maintainer` package is not needed given the near-zero
coupling. Maintainers can continue to use `benchbox-sync` from the source
checkout or via `uv run -- python -m benchbox.release.sync`.

anti_patterns.dont: create a separate benchbox-maintainer package for this level of decoupling
remove benchbox/release/ source code from the repo
anti_patterns.why: maintainers need it for release automation from the source checkout

preserves.behavior: Ability to run release/sync from the source checkout via `uv run`
Public `benchbox` CLI behavior for default installs
Release test coverage (tests still run from source, just not shipped)

work_units.notes:
In pyproject.toml: remove `benchbox-sync = "benchbox.release.sync:main"`
from `[project.scripts]`.
In MANIFEST.in: add `prune benchbox/release` after the existing
`recursive-include benchbox` line.
Update scripts/sync_repos.py to invoke the module directly instead of
relying on the installed entry point.
work_units.summary: Remove benchbox-sync entry point and exclude benchbox/release/ from the wheel

work_units.notes:
Any test asserting `benchbox-sync` is an installed script should be updated
to expect its absence in default installs. CI release jobs that use
`benchbox-sync` should switch to `uv run -- python -m benchbox.release.sync`.
